relevance.rationale: Number theory of multiple polylogarithm values (MPVs) at N-th roots of unity: dimension bounds for the Q-span, and the finding that Racinet's standard double-shuffle/distribution relations are NOT complete at level 4 (weight 3, 4) nor at weight 2 for many N. QOU maintains a live period-depth thread — conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence (tau_arch(G^(n)) subset of Goncharov's period filtration P_n) and the transcendental-accounting ledger, which classifies every period in the paper by Goncharov depth and asks which post-archimedean relations are forced by pre-archimedean q-rational structure versus 'archimedean accidents'. Zhao bears on that ledger in two ways: the Deligne-Goncharov bound D(w,N) caps how many independent constants can exist at a given weight and level, and the incompleteness result is a direct warning that counting standard relations UNDERSTATES the true relation set. This is background/technique for a live thread rather than a result the corpus consumes today, hence supporting, not core. Note QOU's own level-relevant values are MPVs: Vol(4_1) = 2*Cl_2(pi/3) is level 6, and Lambda(pi/4) = G/2 (already cited via lewin1981) is level 4 — the exact level where Zhao finds the standard relations incomplete.

keyResults.statement: d(w,N) <= D(w,N), where the D(w,N) are the coefficients of an explicit generating function depending only on Euler's totient phi(N) and the number of prime factors nu(N).
keyResults.useForFolio: A closed-form upper bound on the number of Q-independent polylog constants of weight w at level N. This is a formalize-first prune of exactly the kind AGENTS.md mandates before a wide search: any PSLQ or closed-form hunt over polylog values at roots of unity (the Lambda(pi/3), Lambda(pi/4), Li_2 at cyclotomic points that populate the transcendental-accounting table) has its basis size bounded a priori by D(w,N), so an over-large candidate basis is refutable on entropy grounds before it is run.

keyResults.statement: There is an explicit Q-linear relation among weight-3, level-4 MPVs (5*Li_{1,2}(-1,-i) = ... , nine terms) that does NOT follow from the standard relations; it is derived instead from the octahedral symmetry of P^1 - ({0, infinity} U mu_4).
keyResults.useForFolio: A concrete counterexample to 'the standard relation set is complete' at exactly the level (4) where the corpus's Catalan/Lambda(pi/4) values live. It supports the ledger's own distinction between relations forced by structure and relations that appear only after archimedean realization — here a genuine extra relation arises from a SYMMETRY (octahedral), not an accident, which is the ledger's Fact-2 mechanism in a different guise.

The transcendental-accounting ledger indexes periods by Goncharov depth but records no dimension bound on the span at a given weight/level. A remark recording D(w,N) as the available upper bound — and Zhao's warning that the standard relations do not exhaust the relations at level 4 — makes the ledger's independence claims auditable rather than asserted.
